description: Question corpus (DH4.4): synthetic questions about a synthetic household, scored by replaying a model's extracted words through the real LookupService. Expected values are the correct product behaviour, never what a model happens to answer. No real captures or owner data.

empty.description: A brand-new install: no tags and nothing logged.

household-q.description: A synthetic household, entries from June 2025 to 4 October 2026.

cases.question: When did I last change the furnace filter?
When was the last time I walked the dogs?
When did I last mow the yard?
cases.note: "yard" is an alias of the Lawn subject.

cases.question: When did I last do anything with the grill?
cases.note: Names only a subject: the action must stay unset.

cases.question: When did I last add chlorine?
cases.note: Names only an action: the subject must stay unset.

cases.question: How many times did I mow the lawn in August?
cases.note: Exactly four Lawn/Mow entries are in August 2026.

cases.question: How many times did I add chlorine to the hot tub this year?
How many times did I walk the dogs last month?
cases.note: "last month" is the previous calendar month.

cases.question: How many times did I change the oil in 2025?
cases.note: Names no subject: the action alone selects the car's oil changes.

cases.question: How many times have I mowed the lawn since June?
How many times did I walk the dogs in the past 30 days?
How many times did I walk the dogs yesterday?
How many times did I do anything with the car this year?

cases.question: How much chlorine did I add to the hot tub last week?
cases.note: "how much" is a count question; "last week" is the previous calendar week (weeks start on Sunday).

cases.question: How often do I change the oil?
cases.note: Names no subject: the action alone selects the car's oil changes (about every four months).

cases.question: How often do I walk the dogs?
How often do I sweep the chimney?
cases.note: Only two entries all time: Explore says there are not enough entries yet to say how often.

cases.question: How often did I mow the lawn in July?
cases.note: Date words on a how-often question set the range chip; the gap itself is an all-time measure.
